Package neqsim.mathlib.linearalgebra

Class LinearAlgebraValidation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mathlib.linearalgebra.LinearAlgebraValidation
final class LinearAlgebraValidation extends Object
Argument checks shared by every LinearAlgebraOperations implementation.

The backends differ in what they tolerate: some accept ragged arrays and propagate NaN silently, others throw library-specific exceptions. Validating here first means every backend rejects the same input the same way, with the same exception type.

    • requireFiniteResult

      static void requireFiniteResult(double[] values, String operation)
      Verify that a computed result contains no non-finite entry.

      A backend that fails to detect a singular system typically returns infinities or NaN rather than throwing, so this is the last line of defence before a meaningless result reaches the caller.

      Parameters:
      values - computed values to check
      operation - name of the operation that produced them, used in the failure message
      Throws:
      LinearAlgebraException - if any value is non-finite
